caption_L1: Earthquakes of magnitude 3.6 and over in Italy between January and May 2020 , by magnitude is a bar plot. Along the y-axis, region of Italy is plotted using a categorical scale starting at Aeolian Islands (Messina) - February 27 and ending at Troina (Enna) - March 2. The x-axis plots Magnitude using a linear scale of range 0 to 4.
caption_L2L3: South tyrrhenien sea had the largest earthquake on the 15th March, Foggia had the smallest earthquake on the 21st January. March and April are the months when most earthquakes occurred.
